content: गुल्मः, -ल्मम् [गुड् मक् डस्य लः <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A clump or cluster of trees, a thicket, wood, bush; विशालगुल्मं प्ररुजन्वनस्पतीन् <ls>Bhāg. 8. 2. 20</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 48</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 192</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">12. 58</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 229</ls>. .²2 A troop of soldiers; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} three सेनामुखs; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Mb. 1. 2. 20</ls>; a division of an army, consisting of 45 foot, 27 horse, 9 chariots and 9 elephants (according to राजघर्मकाण्ड of कृत्यकल्पतरु of लक्ष्मीधर; <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Daṇḍaviveka, G. O. S. 52, p. 31</ls>). .²3 A fort, entrenchment; मध्यमेन च गुल्मेन रक्षिभिः सा सुरक्षिता, <ls>Mb. 3. 15. 11</ls>. .²4 The spleen. .²5 A chronic enlargement of the spleen. .²6 A village police-station. .²7 A wharf of stairs (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>घाट</ns>). .²8 Disciplining an army, keeping it in a posture of defence. .²9 War-camp; तथैव गुल्मे संप्रेक्ष्य शयानान्मध्यगौल्मिकान् <ls>Mb. 10. 8. 41</ls>. .²10 A tent; <ls>Mb. 6. 86. 54</ls>. .{@-ल्मी@} .²1 A cluster or clump of trees. .²2 Jujube. .²3 Small cardamoms. .²4 A tent.
